verdict: Finite objective with verified parent/reference/state layout; behavior untested

sampling.state_order: start then end for each selected source

auxiliary_setup.objective: CE: mean of per-state mean suffix NLL. DPO: mean of two pairs per state, beta-scaled chosen-minus-rejected summed suffix logprob improvement over cached actual parent. No auxiliary prefix weighting or DPO length normalization.
auxiliary_setup.encoding: Chat generation prompt plus unscored separately encoded prefix, then separately encoded suffix and EOS1. End chosen suffix is exactly one EOS token. No clipping.
auxiliary_setup.rng: Independent source shuffle seed+1000; auxiliary forward forks/restores Torch RNG. Both start/end states and two cyclic bank indices per visit.

auxiliary_coverage.state_order: start then end for each selected source
